author: reek
body: A noise oscillator has one job: successive samples must not be predictable from each other, and the output must not repeat. Every other waveform in this chapter is a pure function of phase and SHOULD repeat, because that is what pitch is. Noise is the one that must not.

author: reek
body: The measurement is the definition. Render two and a bit periods and ask whether the second period is the first one again.

author: reek
body: How many of the first two periods are reproduced one period later. A periodic signal scores every one of them.

author: reek
body: How many distinct values appear at all. A signal that repeats every 80 samples can show at most 80 of them however long you render.
